name: 3D/4D Gaussian Splatting Mixture Model
definition: 3D/4DGS represents a radiance field using a large set of 3D Gaussians, parameterized by location and shape, with additional attributes for opacity and color (via spherical harmonics).
summary: The 3D/4D Gaussian Splatting Mixture Model treats radiance fields as probabilistic mixtures of Gaussians, enabling uncertainty modeling through expected color evaluation rather than deterministic splatting.
